Contact us

Call for anything urgent. Email if it can wait and you would rather write it down.

Call 0707 070 707 Email enquiry@sampemail.com

If you smell gas, call this instead

Do not call us and do not email. Leave the building and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999 — free, 24 hours. The same applies if a carbon monoxide alarm sounds.

What to do in a gas or water emergency sets out the full procedure.

How to reach us

By phone

0707 070 707

Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm. Saturday, 9am to 1pm

Phone is the fastest route for anything that needs attention the same day. Outside office hours, emergency calls are answered on the same number until 10pm.

By email

enquiry@sampemail.com

Better for quotations, landlord paperwork and anything with details worth writing down. We answer email within one working day.

By post

Unit 7, Sample Business Park, Demo Road, Birmingham B1 1AA

This is our business address for correspondence. It is not a shop or a trade counter, so please call before coming to the address.

What to have ready

None of this is essential, but each one tends to turn two calls into one.

  • Your postcode, so we can confirm you are in the area
  • The make of the boiler, and the model if it is on the front
  • Any error code on the display — note it before you reset
  • What the fault is doing, and when it started
  • For a landlord check, how many gas appliances are in the property

Where we work

We cover Birmingham and the West Midlands, within 20 miles of the city centre. If you are near the edge of that, ask rather than assume — it costs you a phone call and we will tell you either way.

Complaints

If something has gone wrong, say so and give us the chance to put it right. Call or email and ask for the job to be reviewed. We will respond within five working days and put right anything that is our fault at our cost.

Gas escape or CO alarm

Leave the building and call the National Gas Emergency Service:

0800 111 999

Free, 24 hours. Call them before you call us.
